subject: gse/voice-daemon
body: Sovereign Voice Watchdog Daemon operational with native Windows SAPI voice alerts. intelligence/voice_brain/watchdog_daemon.py watches git/tests/edges/ESPN finals/agent-bus, speaks via SAPI SpVoice on a worker thread (enqueue measured 0.0ms, non-blocking), --test-voice exits 0 with 2 voices detected. Caught a real defect: COM has no apartment on a fresh thread, so the speaker thread failed with 'CoInitialize has not been called' and would have run forever in silence -- fixed with per-thread CoInitialize. The edge watcher refuses to announce artifact edges (requires tier A/B; today's board is all tier C).
